observed_evolution: The historical local filing window changes from 30 days to 5 days and later to 180 days across notice versions.
The public contact transitions from Sheila Stallsworth to Clarissa Hodge in the later notice family.
Later notices align the local filing period with the 180-day FTA window and explicitly support documented/translated oral complaints for LEP individuals.
Later notice versions move from the historical www.4rtec.com domain to www.ridertec.org.

currentness_findings.finding: The current public Required Documents surface was previously observed listing the 'Revised OCT 2016 TITLE VI NOTICE TO PUBLIC' even though the archive contains a January 2026 Board-approved Title VI/LEP plan.
currentness_findings.action: Create/approve a current public notice derived from the governing plan and version every posted notice by effective/revision date.

currentness_findings.finding: The October 2016 notice prints a Kentucky Relay number as 1-800-638-6057, while adjacent historical materials commonly print 1-800-648-6057. Treat this as a source-level discrepancy requiring validation before republication.

controls: A public notice must not be treated as current merely because it names a current coordinator.
Public notice filing windows, coordinator names, phone/relay information, email/domain and external-filing instructions should be validated together against the governing plan.
When a notice is superseded, update vehicle notices, facilities, website, translated/localized pages and downloadable forms as a linked publication set.
